description: For a town, returns the town page, whether companies there are connected, their names and prefill_link. Pass answers and a short description to get prefill_link filled in; they are kept briefly on our server behind the link. The consumer checks the details and sends the request on the town page. Never contact details.

answers.description: Optional answers as option ids from get_service_info, used to fill in prefill_link.

city.description: Town name or the town page slug on this site, for example as the consumer wrote it.

description.description: Optional short description of the job in the consumer's words, for prefill_link. Kept on our server only briefly (see the privacy policy), never in the link itself. No names or contact details.

site.description: The site (domain) from list_sites, for example byggfinder.se.

name: find_providers
title: Find local providers
